title: Hotel reservations in a single-table key-value store: a sort key that isn't unique
name: Hotel stay keys

questions.prompt: Reception in Lisbon reports that families who book several rooms for the same night show up with only one room on the arrivals sheet, and the hotel oversold its deluxe rooms twice last weekend. The guest's "my trips" page still lists every booking. Fix stays/reservations.ts so the tests pass.
